meta.name: Masaba Masaba
meta.description:
Inspired by real events from Masaba Gupta's life, "Masaba Masaba" follows the designer's atypical journey through heterogeneous universes ranging from fashion to family, and documents her return to the singles market.

Ended · First aired 28 Aug 2020 · India · Language: Hindi
Studio: Viniyard Films · Network: Netflix

Complete series. On your server: S1 6/6 | S2 7/7

On your server — Audio: Hindi

videos.title: Rumour Has It
videos.overview: Hours ahead of a fashion awards event, designer-to-the-stars Masaba is caught off guard by gossip across the city about her marriage.

videos.title: I Got It From My Mamma
videos.overview: Masaba deals with social scrutiny, professional pressure, and life back at her mother’s house. Neena scores a meeting with a popular filmmaker.

videos.title: Man! I Feel Like A Woman
videos.overview: Apartment-hunting as a single woman proves challenging, but Masaba is determined to live alone. Neena makes a brave move on social media.

videos.title: Bringing Sexy Back
videos.overview: Masaba and Neena venture out of their comfort zones as one shoots a TV commercial and the other stars in a music video. Masaba enters the dating game.

videos.title: Work B**ch!
videos.overview: Neena lands a leading role. Inspiration finally strikes Masaba for her new collection, but at her show on a luxury boat, it’s one mess after another.

videos.title: Hot Mess
videos.overview: Masaba deals with the fallout from her disastrous launch and faces some long-avoided truths. Neena returns to a movie set for the first time in years.

videos.title: Baby One More Time
videos.overview: ​​At a major fashion show, Masaba is left in the dust when a young influencer steals the spotlight. An offhand remark lands Neena in the news.

videos.title: You Should See Me In A Crown
videos.overview: Masaba sets out to revamp her image by launching a new wedding collection. A job opportunity forces Neena to reconnect with an old flame.

videos.title: Set Fire To The Rain
videos.overview: When an alluring yet unavailable client walks into her life, Masaba attempts to maintain boundaries. Neena hits a snag in the development of her show.

videos.title: Blinding Lights
videos.overview: A pointed remark from Masaba during a fashion reality show causes a stir. At her brand’s 10-year anniversary party, Masaba receives devastating news.

videos.title: A Hard Day's Night
videos.overview: Neena deals with pushback as shooting begins. Gia struggles with her mental health while the loss of a beloved friend leaves Masaba heartbroken.

videos.title: Blurred Lines
videos.overview: Tension builds when Masaba and Fateh are stranded in Kashmir on the way to the wedding. Neena pursues a new vision for the show.

videos.title: I Did It My Way
videos.overview: Following the House of Shaadi debut, Masaba chases a bold direction for her career while finally following her heart. Neena makes a daring move.
